summary: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. filed Form 6-K reporting resolutions adopted at its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on September 8, 2026. All resolutions passed, including setting board size at seven, re-electing five directors, increasing authorized share capital to NIS 30 million divided into 150 million ordinary shares, amending articles and compensation policy, approving equity grants to executives and CEO PSUs, and ratifying auditor appointment. This is a routine corporate governance update with no special-situation transaction, M&A activity, or forced management change. No deal terms or unusual corporate actions are present in the filing.
